shellCommands.command: for f in /workspace/pages/404.js /workspace/pages/_app.js /workspace/pages/_document.js /workspace/pages/_error.js /workspace/pages/index.js; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; done

for f in /workspace/pages/blog/[id].js /workspace/pages/blog/index.js /workspace/pages/api/posts/[id].js /workspace/pages/api/posts/index.js /workspace/components/AppProvider.js; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; done

ls /workspace/node_modules/.package-lock.json 2>/dev/null && echo "installed" || echo "not installed"; ls /workspace/node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null && node -e "console.log(require('/workspace/node_modules/next/package.json').version)" 2>/dev/null
npx tsc --noEmit && echo "TYPES OK"; echo "---"; find app components lib -type f | sort; echo "---"; git status --short

(npx next start -p 3123 &>/tmp/next-start.log &) && sleep 3 && echo "--- GET / ---" && curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' && echo "--- GET /blog/1 ---" && curl -s http://localhost:3123/blog/1 | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' && echo "--- GET /api/posts ---" && curl -s http://localhost:3123/api/posts && echo && echo "--- POST /api/posts (missing body) ---" && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3123/api/posts -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{}' -w ' [%{http_code}]' && echo && echo "--- PUT /api/posts/7 ---" && curl -s -X PUT http://localhost:3123/api/posts/7 -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Hi"}' && echo && echo "--- PATCH /api/posts (undefined method) ---" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X PATCH http://localhost:3123/api/posts && echo && echo "--- GET /nope (404) ---" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3123/nope; pkill -f "next start" || true
